subject.en: A silver-blue American Shorthair head playing with one yarn loop
subject.zh: 拨弄一圈彩色毛线的银蓝美短猫头像

context: A local HTTP bridge and dashboard for Claude, Codex, Copilot, Hermes and Pi coding-agent CLIs.
moment: A curious American Shorthair catches a small yarn loop with one real paw and tilts its face toward the viewer.
interest: One compact loop of multicolored yarn beside the cheek, touched by one natural paw; no second accessory.
paletteDirection: Fresh silver-blue and slate-gray classic tabby markings, ivory muzzle, warm amber eyes; coral, golden yellow, turquoise and violet only on the yarn loop.
